ex-online-one-round-replacement.focus: The fixed k=2,T=3 example compares all-zero losses with replacement of the second complete vector. Verification1.1 proves adjacency and uniform first-two kernels,2.1 computes third-round weights, and3.1 gives the ratio(1+exp(eta))/2 while explicitly preserving the theorem's privacy bound. This is a direct example of differing kernels, not a necessary-and-sufficient criterion.

ex-private-erm-large-finite-class.focus: For d>=1 the Example counts all binary maps on{0,1}^d. Verification1.1–2.1 computes class size2^(2^d),3.1 substitutes its logarithm into a sufficient sample bound, and4.1 counts only the literal exhaustive implementation. It explicitly disclaims a lower bound for all algorithms and asserts no biconditional or converse to the sufficient guarantee.

ex-private-threshold-class-erm.focus: The Example fixes four thresholds, three labeled records and epsilon>0. Verification1.1 enumerates all prediction errors,2.1 evaluates their four weights, and3.1 normalizes the two tied groups. The displayed equalities calculate this supplied example; they do not assert an iff characterization of general private ERM or a reverse implication from output probabilities.
